WITH c AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
  FROM c
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s
)
SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.av) AS avg_above_average
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.av;
WITH c AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS cnt
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
s AS (
    SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM c
),
m AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - m.avg_share) AS avg_above_average_share
FROM s, m
WHERE s.share > m.avg_share;
WITH c AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
t AS (
    SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM c
),
s AS (
    SELECT c.account_id,
           c.cnt,
           1.0 * c.cnt / t.total AS share,
           1.0 / t.n AS avg_share
    FROM c, t
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_orders,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share
FROM s
WHERE share > avg_share;
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT account_id, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS share
    FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_orders,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS average_excess
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
